answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a refundable stake that vests slowly, like basalt cooling into solid rock: creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand deposits, so forgery stops paying. A newcomer must then forge a public record of useful, verifiable work before its votes count at full weight, and at dawn of each epoch the network audits stake against activity, slashing identities that appear only to vote and vanish.
